answer: Mechanism: proof-of-space-time plot commitment. Each identity seals a 32 GiB plot and publishes its Merkle root on-chain. Every epoch the randomness beacon opens 64 indices; a miss inside one block forfeits the bond. Plots re-seal quarterly, so storage cost never stops. Forging 1,000 sybils needs 32 TiB of NVMe plus 90 days of sealing, about $60,000 in drives and 14,000 core-hours; rented cloud plots burn $9,000 monthly. A quill once bought a thousand fake names; now each name is a sealed warehouse you must keep paying for — no cheap haven, no free sonnet of identities to sing with.
